summary: Avoid a shared mutable default: default tags to None and give every note its own list.

edits.old: def __init__(self, title: str, body: str = "", tags: list[str] = []) -> None:
edits.new: def __init__(self, title: str, body: str = "", tags: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
self.tags = [] if tags is None else list(tags)
